mapper.sql: ID, JOB_ID, PICTURE, ISSUE_STATE, ISSUE_MACHINE, ISSUE_TIME, TYPE
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM PPM_KQ_FACE_CONFIG
JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND ID = #{id} AND

SELECT FC.ID, OB.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, CD.ADMINID, OB.USER_NAME, OB.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN FC.PICTURE IS NULL THEN OB.FACEIMAGE ELSE FC.PICTURE END PICTURE, FC.ISSUE_MACHINE, CASE WHEN FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE FC.ISSUE_STATE END ISSUE_STATE, OB.PRESENCE_STATE, FC.ISSUE_TIME, OB.STATE, 'CADRE' TYPE FROM PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_FACE_CONFIG FC ON OB.JOB_ID = FC.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID
OB.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND
ORDER BY OB.ID DESC

SELECT FC.ID, OB.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, CD.ADMINID, OB.USER_NAME, OB.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN FC.PICTURE IS NULL THEN OB.FACEIMAGE ELSE FC.PICTURE END PICTURE, FC.ISSUE_MACHINE, CASE WHEN FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE FC.ISSUE_STATE END ISSUE_STATE, OB.PRESENCE_STATE, FC.ISSUE_TIME, OB.STATE, 'CADRE' TYPE FROM PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_FACE_CONFIG FC ON OB.JOB_ID = FC.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID
OB.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND OB.USER_NAME like '%'||#{userName}||'%' AND OB.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND (FC.ISSUE_STATE = #{issueState} OR FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL ) AND FC.ISSUE_STATE = #{issueState} AND OB.PRESENCE_STATE = #{presenceState} AND OB.STATE = #{state} AND CD.ADMINID = #{adminId} AND
ORDER BY OB.ID DESC

SELECT FC.ID, OP.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OP.USER_NAME, OP.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN FC.PICTURE IS NULL THEN OP.IMAGE_NO ELSE FC.PICTURE END PICTURE, FC.ISSUE_MACHINE, CASE WHEN FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE FC.ISSUE_STATE END ISSUE_STATE, OP.STATE, FC.ISSUE_TIME, 'OTHER' TYPE FROM PPM_OUTSOURCE_PERSONLEDGE OP LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_FACE_CONFIG FC ON OP.JOB_ID = FC.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OP.PRO_PERSON = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OP.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID
OP.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND
ORDER BY OP.ID DESC

SELECT FC.ID, OP.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OP.USER_NAME, OP.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN FC.PICTURE IS NULL THEN OP.IMAGE_NO ELSE FC.PICTURE END PICTURE, FC.ISSUE_MACHINE, CASE WHEN FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE FC.ISSUE_STATE END ISSUE_STATE, OP.STATE, FC.ISSUE_TIME, 'OTHER' TYPE FROM PPM_OUTSOURCE_PERSONLEDGE OP LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_FACE_CONFIG FC ON OP.JOB_ID = FC.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OP.PRO_PERSON = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OP.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID
OP.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND OP.USER_NAME like '%${userName}%' AND CD.LOCATION like '%${deptName}%' AND (FC.ISSUE_STATE = #{issueState} OR FC.ISSUE_STATE IS NULL ) AND FC.ISSUE_STATE = #{issueState} AND OP.STATE = #{state} AND CD.ADMINID = #{adminId} AND
ORDER BY OP.ID DESC
